intro: For those who seek style and security, Centurion Plus delivers. With a mirror, biometric lock, and retractable hangers, it redefines organisation while keeping your space safe and sophisticated.

features.title: Steel strength that lasts for years
features.text: Made from premium CRCA steel, this wardrobe is built to handle everyday use while staying resistant to dents, rust, and wear for long-lasting durability.

features.title: Light up your space effortlessly
features.text: The motion-activated LED light illuminates the interior as soon as you open the door, making it easy to find what you need, even during late nights or early mornings.

features.title: Safe and organised storage for essentials
features.text: With a secure locker and two spacious drawers, you can keep your valuables safe while staying organised, no matter how busy your day gets.

features.title: Flexible storage that adapts to you
features.text: Customisable shelves ensure that everything has a place, giving you the freedom to organise your clothing and essentials exactly the way you want.

features.title: Integrated mirror and stunning finish
features.text: The full-length mirror paired with rich garnet finish not only enhances your daily routine but adds elegance to your room, creating a stylish and welcoming space.

name: Centurion Plus 2-Door Steel Almirah With Mirror And Motion Sensor Lights Bond White
